review_scope.source_metadata_and_binding_review: All 456 source titles and explicit mechanism, focus and observation bindings.
review_scope.current_official_document_review: The three individually authored DNS, VM maintenance and Azure OpenAI regional-routing pilots plus sixteen expanded conditional guides. Those sixteen reconcile historical source claims in their primary explanations and use current scoped official documentation; the Citrix case also explicitly records its current public vendor source.
review_scope.remaining_review: The other 437 entries combine pinned source descriptions and benefits with mechanism and service-domain explanations. Their current official documentation has not been independently revalidated in this task. Guidance is not evaluator coverage or operational success.

quality_limits: Three pilots and sixteen expanded conditional guides have individually authored explanations and diagrams grounded in scoped current public documentation. The other 437 entries combine pinned source descriptions and benefits, explicit per-GUID mechanism and observation bindings, shared bilingual mechanism context and applicable service-domain cautions.

The 437 shared-context entries instantiate reusable conceptual diagram families with recommendation-specific focus and observation details. They are not 437 independently designed deployment topologies.

The Korean reader-text source contains reviewed, source-pinned field overrides. Localization remains incomplete until every reader field across all 456 recommendations is translated; the authoring build fails closed for English-only or English-wrapped reader text. Source citation labels are excluded.

No live Azure or model validation was performed. Structural completeness, source pins and focused semantic tests do not establish evaluator coverage, current support for every source recommendation or operational compliance.

content_critique.scope: Offline source-title, explanation, benefit, explicit binding and mechanism-graph critique across all 456 IDs, plus scoped current-public-document review and rewritten conditional guidance for sixteen cases. No claim that all 437 shared-context entries have independent latest-document review; no live validation.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Configure static routes for session hosts to directly access the AVD control plane subnet
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Direct Internet routing for trusted AVD control-plane traffic requires current service destinations and security review. It does not justify blanket inspection bypass.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Use Azure Site Recovery to protect stateful session hosts
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Disabled source describes ASR as replication or backup and mentions region or zone. Exact supported replication topology must be confirmed; ASR is not an independent backup.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Review SAP configuration for timeout values used with Azure NetApp Files
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: SAP and ANF timeout values depend on the supported application, OS and client stack. The source does not supply a universal numeric timeout.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Enable zone redundancy
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Pinned ACR metadata describes an optional zone setting; current tier and region service behavior must be checked before prescribing an explicit toggle.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Ensure the Pacemaker cluster has been setup for SAP HANA DB high availability
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Source requests correct HANA Pacemaker parameters without enumerating the supported cluster contract. A complete current vendor HA configuration is still needed.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Enable Availability Zones on Premium API Management instances
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: APIM source describes gateway and control-plane zone replication together. Current tier and platform scope must be verified before extending a gateway claim to every management component.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Ensure zone redundancy is enabled in supported regions
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Pinned Event Hubs metadata contrasts portal and IaC defaults. Current namespace and tier behavior is not established by those historical defaults.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Ensure Resource Group and its Resources are located in the same Region
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Source overgeneralizes resource-group metadata region into resource placement. Universal relocation is not justified.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Configure a Pacemaker cluster for SAP ASCS high availability
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Source requests correct ASCS Pacemaker parameters without enumerating the supported cluster contract. A complete current vendor HA configuration is still needed.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Enable Stretched Clusters for Multi-AZ Availability of the vSAN Datastore
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: AVS stretched-cluster creation, quota, SLA and synchronous vSAN claims are source-specific. Current eligibility and application-level recovery need separate verification.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Recover ETL jobs based on Delta time travel
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Delta time-travel title is specific, but description does not define retained-version selection, recovery semantics or supported ETL repair procedure.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Enable AZ support in AI Search by configuring multiple replicas to your search service
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: AI Search replica count and zone distribution vary with service support and generation. A replica count alone cannot prove current zone placement.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Do not create more than 4000 Citrix VDA servers per subscription
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: The 4000 VDA source limit concerns Citrix Managed Azure subscriptions, not all Azure subscriptions; current vendor limit and catalog scope need confirmation.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Ensure the standard FSLogix configuration is deployed
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Source says standard FSLogix configuration without naming supported baseline values. No universal configuration values are invented.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: Disabled Fallback Route
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Title says Disabled Fallback Route but description warns against disabling fallback. Action polarity requires manual source interpretation.

source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.title: SAP shared files systems are replicated or backed up to DR location
source_ambiguities_and_historical_limits.reason: Title concerns SAP shared-file replication or backup, but description discusses monitoring. Required protection method is not established by that description.

resolved_conditional_guides.resolution: Rewritten primary summary and benefit, scoped mechanism explanation, three implementation steps, three verification questions and an individually authored conditional diagram.
deployment_prerequisites: Does the AVD Agent URL Tool or retained equivalent validate every required endpoint category from the actual session hosts?
Do effective routes and security rules preserve the reviewed path for each required destination without exposing unrelated outbound traffic?
Are identity, DNS, storage and update dependencies verified independently, and are no unnecessary inbound ports opened for ordinary AVD control-plane access?

Can persistent profiles and required data recover independently, and does the plan distinguish replication, retained backup and image-based recreation?

Does the proposed repair preserve required inputs and reconcile previously committed outputs and consumer checkpoints?

resolved_conditional_guides.resolution: Rewritten primary summary and benefit, scoped mechanism explanation, three implementation steps, three verification questions and an individually authored conditional diagram.
deployment_prerequisites: Does the selected baseline actually match single-connection Standard versus Cloud Cache or concurrent-session requirements?
Can a representative authorized user attach the existing intended container with the correct permissions and no unexpected temporary or new empty profile?

resolved_conditional_guides.resolution: Rewritten primary summary and benefit, scoped mechanism explanation, three implementation steps, three verification questions and an individually authored conditional diagram.

content_critique.resolution_scope: The sixteen identified instructional gaps only. Installation-specific eligibility and effect observations remain unknown until supplied. The other 437 shared-context entries do not gain independent latest-document review from these resolutions.

vendor_source_cards.reviewed_scope: Citrix DaaS Standard for Azure currently lists 5000 VDAs per subscription; the APRL 4000 figure is historical and not an Azure-wide quota.
vendor_source_cards.handling: The guide includes a vendor source card for this exact public URL. No other vendor origins or paths are enabled by this record.

corrected_mechanism_bindings.reason: Registry geo-replication distributes image artifacts and pull availability, not workload-state recovery.
SAP backup and ASR are distinct choices in a component recovery plan, not equivalent independent backups.
ML registry replication distributes artifacts; it is not gateway routing or automatic training-job failover.
Regional Application Insights resources provide monitoring coverage, not model-request traffic failover.
Regional isolation here means Databricks workspace/control-plane locality, not a secondary workspace or regional traffic failover.
Domain Services replica sets are explicit replicas with network prerequisites, not a generic customer gateway failover mechanism.
Image-version regional replicas protect deployable artifacts, not running VM or application state.
The three-image-replica source recommendation concerns parallel deployment capacity and throttling, not a three-instance application HA guarantee.
SAP shared-file protection needs an explicit recovery choice; the source description only addresses monitoring.

content_critique.assessment_boundary: Manual and blocked dispositions are evidence limits, not automatically thin content and not changed by guidance quality.
content_critique.classification_limit: Subscription-scoped specialized-workload metadata is not the actual target object type; inspect the explicit recommendation focus and workload dependencies.

semantic_review_gaps.reason: The source title says Disabled Fallback Route while its description warns that disabling fallback risks undelivered messages. Preserve the title, explain the delivery mechanism and require manual interpretation rather than instructing an unchecked disable action.

Resource-group metadata location and contained resource location are distinct. Explain the source management-plane continuity concern without asserting that all resources must universally share their group's region.
